description: Add ONE skill to the company library: an instruction every Code Studio and Crew agent reads verbatim when it applies. Use it to turn a team's documents into skills: one skill per distinct procedure or rule set (never one per paragraph, never one giant skill), keeping only what the document says. Show the person the skills you will add and add them only after they agree. name is unique in the library; category is lower-case and hyphenated (coding-standards, workflow, governance, communication); description is ONE line saying when the skill applies; content is up to 8000 characters (split a longer document by topic). Never put credentials, tokens, customer data or personal data in a skill. Errors to handle: 409 duplicate_skill (a skill has that name: pick another name or leave it), 409 similar_skill (one already covers the same rule: tell the person; pass force: true only if they want both), 409 skill_content_flagged (the text asks an agent to weaken a safeguard: rewrite it, or the person saves it from the Skills page). The skill is not offered to the Oracle until an Owner or Operator turns that on. Requires `write` scope and the Owner, Operator or Editor role.

content.description: The instruction agents read verbatim, up to 8000 characters.

description.description: One line, at most 200 characters, saying when the skill applies.

force.description: Add even though a skill with the same intent exists. Only when the person asked for both.

languages.description: Only for repositories in these languages. Every language when left out.

name.description: What a teammate would call the skill.
